name: hud_ui_main_menu_dialog_destructor
description: HudUiMainMenuDialog::Destructor destroys the eight ZRD button members in reverse construction order and then destroys the HudUiBackground base.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; no VC target currently covers 0x415040.
Reconstruction remains limited because Binary Ninja exposes MSVC SEH cleanup scaffolding around the source-level destructor body.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x415040 validates reverse destruction of controls, quit, options, new-game, load, save, back, and credits button members followed by HudUiBackground::Destructor.

Native smoke hud_ui_main_menu_dialog_destructor_smoke constructs a frontend main-menu dialog, calls HudUiMainMenuDialog::Destructor, verifies all eight button members reached the common HudUiWidget destructor-table state, and verifies the base container reached the HudUiContainer destructor-table state.
